Shares Outstanding (MM).notes: Reported common shares outstanding as of the filing's latest practicable date.

EV / LTM EBITDAX.notes: Calculated = (market capitalization + total debt - cash and cash equivalents) / LTM Adjusted EBITDAX. Blank where source inputs are unavailable.

Normalized Operating Cash Flow (Pre-WC).notes: Calculated = GAAP cash flow from operations with all working-capital movements reversed. Use the cash-flow statement sign convention; exclude working-capital timing effects.

Normalized Free Cash Flow.notes: Calculated = Normalized Operating Cash Flow (Pre-WC) - Normalized Capital Expenditures. Exclude asset-sale proceeds, acquisitions/divestitures, debt activity, dividends, and share repurchases.

Normalized EBITDAX.notes: Calculated from a consistent peer reconciliation: Net income + interest + income taxes + DD&A + exploration + impairments/abandonments ± unrealized derivative fair-value adjustments ± approved consistent non-operating adjustments.

Normalized Capital Expenditures.notes: Calculated = organic E&P capital incurred: drilling/completion/development + facilities/infrastructure + land/leasehold/acreage + other organic E&P capital. Prefer accrual/incurred basis; exclude acquisitions.

Normalized Net Debt.notes: Calculated = face-value gross debt - cash and cash equivalents. Use consistent debt scope across peers.

LTM Normalized EBITDAX.notes: Calculated = sum of the most recent four standalone quarterly Normalized EBITDAX values. Do not annualize a single quarter when four actual quarters are available.

Normalized Reinvestment Rate.notes: Calculated = Normalized Capital Expenditures / Normalized EBITDAX.

Normalized FCF Conversion.notes: Calculated = Normalized Free Cash Flow / Normalized EBITDAX.

Normalized Net Debt / LTM EBITDAX.notes: Calculated = quarter-end Normalized Net Debt / LTM Normalized EBITDAX.

Enterprise Value.notes: Calculated = equity market capitalization + gross debt + preferred equity + noncontrolling interest - cash and cash equivalents. Include other debt-like claims only under a consistent policy.

EV / LTM Normalized EBITDAX.notes: Calculated = Enterprise Value / LTM Normalized EBITDAX. Use market value and balance-sheet inputs aligned to the same measurement date.

Normalized FCF Yield.notes: Calculated = LTM Normalized Free Cash Flow / equity market capitalization. Use only when the Normalized FCF methodology is consistently populated.

Normalized FCF / Mcfe.notes: Calculated = Normalized Free Cash Flow / total production Mcfe for the quarter. Convert quarterly average daily production to total quarterly Mcfe before dividing.

Normalized EBITDAX / Mcfe.notes: Calculated = Normalized EBITDAX / total production Mcfe for the quarter. Convert quarterly average daily production to total quarterly Mcfe before dividing.

Normalized Free Cash Flow.notes: Calculated = Normalized Operating Cash Flow (Pre-WC) - Normalized Capital Expenditures. Exclude asset-sale proceeds, acquisitions/divestitures, debt activity, dividends, and share repurchases.

Normalized Capital Expenditures.notes: Calculated = organic E&P capital incurred: drilling/completion/development + facilities/infrastructure + land/leasehold/acreage + other organic E&P capital. Prefer accrual/incurred basis; exclude acquisitions.

Normalized Realized Oil / Condensate Pri.notes: Calculated = oil/condensate revenue before hedge settlements / oil/condensate barrels sold. Keep hedging effects separate.

Normalized Gas Differential vs Benchmark.notes: Calculated = Normalized Realized Natural Gas Price (Pre-Hedge) - selected benchmark gas price for the same period. Benchmark must be applied consistently and documented.

Total Normalized Cash Unit Cost.notes: Calculated = (LOE + gathering/processing/transportation + cash G&A + production/severance taxes) / total production Mcfe. Normalize classification differences across peers.

Normalized FCF / Mcfe.notes: Calculated = Normalized Free Cash Flow / total production Mcfe for the quarter. Convert quarterly average daily production to total quarterly Mcfe before dividing.

Normalized EBITDAX / Mcfe.notes: Calculated = Normalized EBITDAX / total production Mcfe for the quarter. Convert quarterly average daily production to total quarterly Mcfe before dividing.

Normalized Operating Cash Flow (Pre-WC).notes: Calculated = GAAP cash flow from operations with all working-capital movements reversed. Use the cash-flow statement sign convention; exclude working-capital timing effects.

Normalized Free Cash Flow.notes: Calculated = Normalized Operating Cash Flow (Pre-WC) - Normalized Capital Expenditures. Exclude asset-sale proceeds, acquisitions/divestitures, debt activity, dividends, and share repurchases.

Normalized EBITDAX.notes: Calculated from a consistent peer reconciliation: Net income + interest + income taxes + DD&A + exploration + impairments/abandonments ± unrealized derivative fair-value adjustments ± approved consistent non-operating adjustments.

Normalized Capital Expenditures.notes: Calculated = organic E&P capital incurred: drilling/completion/development + facilities/infrastructure + land/leasehold/acreage + other organic E&P capital. Prefer accrual/incurred basis; exclude acquisitions.

Normalized FCF Conversion.notes: Calculated = Normalized Free Cash Flow / Normalized EBITDAX.

Normalized FCF Yield.notes: Calculated = LTM Normalized Free Cash Flow / equity market capitalization. Use only when the Normalized FCF methodology is consistently populated.
